api.transport: import {FrameTransport} from tools/terminal-handoff-spike/node/frame-transport.mjs; new FrameTransport({session,view,epoch,ack}); apply(frame); drawTicket(); drawComplete(ticket,evidence)
api.fixture: cargo run --locked --bin view-fixture emits full + damage from actual singleton canonical alacritty Snapshot, with structured Unicode/width/fg/bg/flags cells, no byte parsing in views.

frame.base_revision: null for full, exact acknowledged revision string for damage

hostRules: Apply frame atomically only after validation. Missing base, stale epoch, dropped/out-of-order revision => reject/request full. Never redraw old ticket after newer revision applied.
Native host must send applied after GPU scene update and drawn only after actual native draw callback for EXACT epoch+revision; callback is not guaranteed compositor/scanout presentation.

WebView onAck must be delivered over host IPC; JavaScript cannot attest physical present. Do not reinterpret phase=drawn as physical presentation. First-frame gate must document accepted evidence level explicitly.
No private xterm hooks, no xterm parser; view is canonical state Canvas2D. Production feature parity (selection, IME, full flags, history paging, scaling and accessibility) remains separate work.
Fixture resolves OSC palette overrides to RGB before frame emission; production native-core worker can use same structured cell contract without importing this test session core.

realSmoke.engine: installed WebKitGTK 2.52.3 via minimal ctypes GTK host and loopback module server
realSmoke.observed: real requestAnimationFrame draw callbacks for full revision1 + damage revision2; real Canvas getImageData bright pixel check

ownership: No files in native-host-spike or native-terminal-core edited. This module/fixture is available for the other worker to import.
